about: Defence moves (3.3 batch, lane A): the species whose own stored text says they curl into a ball, withdraw into a shell, puff up, drop the tail or flash hidden wing colour or eyespots when a predator is near, with the row's sentence for the live log. Built by scripts/ark-defence-moves.mts from AnimalDex docs/ark/signature-behaviours.json; never edited by hand.

species.name: African Pygmy Hedgehog
species.line: {aAnimal} is curling up to protect its softest parts
species.behaviour: curls into a spiny ball
species.quote: Curling behavior protects the softest parts first

species.name: Algerian Millipede
species.line: {aAnimal} is rolling into a flat spiral after a disturbance
species.behaviour: rolls into a flat spiral when disturbed
species.quote: Rolls into a flat spiral when disturbed

species.name: American Giant Millipede
species.line: {aAnimal} is coiling into a tight spiral and lying still
species.behaviour: coils into a tight spiral and lies still
species.quote: Its first response is to coil into a tight spiral that shields the legs and soft underside, lying still until the danger passes.

species.name: Asian Forest Tortoise
species.line: {aAnimal} is drawing back into its shell
species.behaviour: withdraws into shell
species.quote: It withdraws into its shell when disturbed.

species.name: Asian Tramp Snail
species.line: {aAnimal} is pulling back into its shell at a touch
species.behaviour: pulls back into shell when touched
species.quote: It pulls back into the shell when touched.

species.name: Ball Python
species.line: {aAnimal} is curling into a tight ball with its head tucked inside the coils
species.behaviour: curls into a tight ball with head tucked when threatened
species.quote: When threatened or stressed, Ball Pythons curl into a tight, compact ball, tucking their head safely within the coils.

species.name: Danube River Snail
species.line: {aAnimal} is pulling into its shell and shutting the opening with its hard lid
species.behaviour: pulls into shell and shuts it with a hard lid
species.quote: Threatened, the snail pulls its body into the shell and shuts the opening with its hard lid.

species.name: Eastern Box Turtle
species.line: {aAnimal} is closed up tight inside its shell
species.behaviour: closes up fully inside hinged shell
species.quote: A closed-up adult resists most attacks

species.name: European Hedgehog
species.line: {aAnimal} is rolling into a spiny ball at a threat
species.behaviour: rolls into a spiny ball when threatened
species.quote: European Hedgehogs roll into a spiny ball when strongly threatened.

species.name: European Pond Terrapin
species.line: {aAnimal} is pulling its head and limbs inside its hard shell
species.behaviour: withdraws head and limbs into shell
species.quote: can pull the head and limbs inside the hard shell

species.name: Flamed Tigersnail
species.line: {aAnimal} is withdrawing into its shell
species.behaviour: withdraws into shell, shelters in litter by day
species.quote: It withdraws into its shell and shelters in damp leaf litter, logs and crevices by day.

species.name: Giant African Land Snail
species.line: {aAnimal} is pulling deep into its shell after a disturbance
species.behaviour: pulls deep into shell when disturbed
species.quote: A disturbed snail pulls deep into its shell.

species.name: Giant African Millipede
species.line: {aAnimal} is coiling its body into a tight spiral at a threat
species.behaviour: coils into a tight spiral when threatened
species.quote: When threatened, the Giant African Millipede typically coils its body into a tight spiral, protecting its vulnerable underside and presenting its harder exoskeleton.

species.name: Greek Tortoise
species.line: {aAnimal} is pulled into its shell with scaly forelimbs closing the front
species.behaviour: pulls into shell and closes front with scaly forelimbs
species.quote: Nosed by a fox or dog, it pulls head, legs and tail into the shell, closes the front with its scaly forelimbs and stays put.

species.name: Grovesnail
species.line: {aAnimal} is rapidly pulling its soft body back into its hard shell
species.behaviour: retracts instantly at a bird's shadow or touch
species.quote: Upon sensing a threat, such as a bird's shadow, a sudden vibration, or a direct touch, the Grovesnail rapidly retracts its soft body into the safety of its hard, calcified shell.

species.name: Malayan Box Turtle
species.line: {aAnimal} is clamping its lower shell shut, sealed into a hard box
species.behaviour: seals itself into a hinged box
species.quote: Grabbed or threatened, it pulls head, legs and tail inside and clamps its lower shell tight against the upper one, sealing itself into a hard box with no gap to bite into.

species.name: Mediterranean Hermit Crab
species.line: {aAnimal} is deep in its shell, blocking the opening with its large right claw
species.behaviour: withdraws and blocks opening with large right claw
species.quote: It withdraws deep into its shell and blocks the opening with its large right claw

species.name: Pill Millipede
species.line: {aAnimal} is curling up tightly at a touch and staying closed
species.behaviour: rolls into a tight ball within a second and stays closed
species.quote: Touched on a woodland floor, it curls up within a second and stays tightly closed until the disturbance has passed.

species.name: Pointed Snail
species.line: {aAnimal} is withdrawing into its shell after a disturbance
species.behaviour: withdraws into its shell when disturbed
species.quote: When disturbed it withdraws into its shell.

species.name: Reeves' Turtle
species.line: {aAnimal} is withdrawing into its shell
species.behaviour: withdraws into shell
species.quote: Adults withdraw into the shell

species.name: Rugose Hermit Crab
species.line: {aAnimal} is pulling back into its shell and blocking the opening with a claw
species.behaviour: pulls into shell and blocks with claw, or lets go and drops
species.quote: Its answer to a threat is to pull back into the shell and block the opening with a claw, or to let go of its foothold and drop.

species.name: Short-beaked Echidna
species.line: {aAnimal} is digging in and curling up
species.behaviour: digs in and curls up against predators
species.quote: Digging in and curling make defense portable.

species.name: Sunda Pangolin
species.line: {aAnimal} is curling up tight against a threat
species.behaviour: rolls up into a scaly ball
species.quote: Curling works against many predators
